name: Danitha Capashen
description: Aron's daughter, who slew the compleated Aron and led House Capashen.

description_citations.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Danitha Capashen refuses to join, bound to defend Benalia.
timeline.quote: I'm sworn to defend this land.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff Capashen volunteers to go in his sister's place.
timeline.quote: I'm a Capashen. I'm Raff.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Danitha Capashen declares honor rides before them.
timeline.quote: "Honor rides before us. All we have to do is catch up."

citation.text: Charge (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Danitha Capashen vows to protect the less fortunate and face despair, as a Capashen.
timeline.quote: "I will protect the less fortunate. I will love bravely.

citation.text: Danitha Capashen, Paragon (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jaya meets Ajani and Danitha Capashen, who is searching for her kidnapped father, and joins them to attack the Phyrexian cave.
timeline.quote: "Well, one sure way to get someone out of a cave is smoke."

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jaya, Ajani and Danitha's forces attack the cave, burning the guards, but are overwhelmed when more Phyrexians pour out.
timeline.quote: The Benalish were being overwhelmed.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ertai orders Aron to attack Danitha, and Danitha beheads her father.
timeline.quote: separating his head from his shoulders.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ertai threatens to have the dreadnought kill everyone unless Jaya and Ajani surrender, and Danitha stops the fight.
timeline.quote: "If you don't give yourselves up to me," Ertai said

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jaya, Danitha, Radha and the Keldon and Benalish warriors pour from the Argosy; Jaya burns Phyrexians with fire and lightning.
timeline.quote: Keldon warriors and Benalish knights poured from the Argosy onto the Mana Rig's decks.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jodah portals Danitha, Radha, Meria and the troops to safety and steps through his final portal.
timeline.quote: Jodah pulled up a portal and threw Danitha, Radha, and Meria into it

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Danitha sees Jaya blast charging Phyrexians with lightning.
timeline.quote: Danitha watched in shock as electricity lanced from Jaya's fingertips, obliterating the charging Phyrexians.

citation.text: Lightning Strike (Dominaria United, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the Oyster Bay summit Aron, found compleated, is killed by his daughter Danitha.
timeline.quote: Houses Capashen and Tarmula joined to rescue Aron, but when it was discovered that he had already been compleated, he was killed by his daughter, Danitha .

citation.text: "Benalia", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Aerona Jaya fights compleated Ertai and Aron Capashen and is rescued by Radha, then is killed by compleated Ajani at the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: She was killed by a compleated Ajani Goldmane at the Battle of the Mana Rig .

citation.text: "Jaya Ballard", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The compleated Aron fights at Aerona and is slain by his daughter Danitha, who takes over House Capashen.
timeline.quote: he was confronted and ultimately slain by his grieving daughter, Danitha Capashen

citation.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Danitha takes up leadership of House Capashen sooner than she hoped.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Danitha had spent her whole life preparing to lead House Capashen, but she mourned that the opportunity had come so soon.

citation.series: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
citation.text: Danitha, New Benalia's Light (March of the Machine: The Aftermath, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Across the Multiverse the worlds begin to overlay; on Ravnica, Bloomburrow, Amonkhet and Dominaria, people see doubles of their worlds.
timeline.quote: Meanwhile, the worlds begin to overlay.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Ertai compleats Aron Capashen and Danitha kills him.
timeline.quote: Compleated by Ertai and killed by Danitha

citation.text: "Clan Capashen", section "Members". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Danitha refuses Jhoira's request to join the new Weatherlight crew; Raff goes in her stead.
timeline.quote: Danitha refused Jhoira 's request to become part of the new Weatherlight crew

citation.text: "Danitha Capashen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Danitha leads the rescue of her captured father with Jaya and Ajani.
timeline.quote: she led the effort to rescue him with Jaya Ballard and Ajani Goldmane

citation.text: "Danitha Capashen", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aron is revealed compleated; Danitha kills him and becomes leader of House Capashen.
timeline.quote: Danitha killed him and assumed his role as leader of House Capashen

citation.text: "Danitha Capashen", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse Danitha becomes Belzenlok's right hand and leads his forces against Benalia.
timeline.quote: Danitha has taken up her father's role as the right hand of Belzenlok

citation.text: "Danitha Capashen", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Josu Vess strikes Danitha with Whisper's blade at Blighted Fields; she and Raf feel the Legacy Curse.
timeline.quote: Josu struck her with Whisper 's blade

citation.text: "Danitha Capashen", section "Magic: Legends". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Raff offers to join the Weatherlight after Danitha refuses.
timeline.quote: Raff offered to join the Weatherlight after his sister Danitha refused that position.

citation.text: "Raff Capashen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Danitha Capashen musters Benalish troops in the mountains before pushing east against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: used as a staging ground by Danitha Capashen and her Benalish troops

citation.text: "Red Iron Mountains", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

relations.note: The Keldons join the Benalish knights against the dreadnought.
relations.quote: Radha herself led her warriors onto the Phyrexian dreadnought's battering-ram head.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

relations.note: Meria fights alongside Radha and Danitha and coordinates her archers behind them.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.
